subject: Re: onboarding entry point
body: Yes to both shapes: headless run({mode, speech}) -> Promise<Profile> plus mount(el, {onDone, onStop}) for your Onboard and Calibrate slots. The scripted path is the default, offline, about 60 s, with a fast-forward flag. Calibration writes emotions[i].calibration. A safety stop resolves to a stopped result (shape pending contracts), which your app should render as an end screen.
